provenance.rationale: Switched the synchronous single-thread harness from process CPU to calling-thread CPU after unchanged renderer code produced 0.185 ms and 0.547 ms combined p95 in consecutive process-clock runs while p50 stayed stable. Thread-CPU calibrations from CI run 29363711962 jobs 87189922733 and 87192352431 aggregated to 0.071/0.386/0.460 ms and 0.015/0.138/0.157 ms p95 for decode/apply, command preparation, and combined work. The conservative first run is checked in, rounded upward to three decimals. The five-batch median, 1.20x regression ratio, 0.05 ms noise allowance, and hard-coded 4 ms stage and 8 ms combined ceilings remain authoritative.
